idea-plugin.name: Throwable Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
Highlights Throwable and Java classes that inherit from it.

Highlights class declarations and references, class names in explicit imports, types in catch parameters and throws clauses, and class names in Javadoc @throws and @exception tags on methods and constructors.

Provides separate attributes for checked types, runtime exceptions, and errors in class declarations, references, and catch parameters. Each type in a multi-catch parameter receives its category's attributes.

Configure colors under Editor | Color Scheme | Throwable Highlighter. The Class and Catch groups contain base and category attributes. Separate settings are available for Import, Throws, and Javadoc.

Category attributes inherit the base attributes of their group. Catch base attributes, imports, throws clauses, and Javadoc inherit class base attributes by default.

Choose a highlighting source for each context under Tools | Throwable Highlighter. The plugin source uses the configured color scheme attributes. Choose Java highlighting to use the IDE's standard highlighting for that context.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.5.0

  • Adds independent highlighting source selection for class declarations and references, explicit imports, catch, throws, and supported Javadoc tags.
  • Choose plugin attributes or Java highlighting for each context under Tools | Throwable Highlighter.
  • Existing catch source settings carry over from version 1.4.0.

1.4.0

  • Adds configurable highlighting for Throwable class names in Javadoc @throws and @exception tags on methods and constructors.
  • Throwable Javadoc inherits the Throwable class color by default.
  • Adds an application-wide catch highlighting source selector under Tools | Throwable Highlighter.
  • Supports switching between Throwable catch and Java highlighting while preserving configured color scheme attributes.
  • Reduces unnecessary PSI ancestor traversal when determining highlighting contexts.

1.3.0

  • Adds a separate configurable color for Throwable types in throws clauses.
  • Throwable throws inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.2.0

  • Adds a separate configurable color for Throwable types in catch clauses.
  • Throwable catch inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.1.0

  • Adds configurable highlighting for imports of Throwable and its subclasses.
  • Highlights only the imported class name.
  • Import highlighting inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.0.0

  • Highlights Java classes inheriting from Throwable.
  • Highlights both class declarations and references.
  • Supports transitive Throwable inheritance.
  • Adds configurable highlighting under the IDE color scheme settings.
